newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Remain lightly quoted on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Remain lightly quoted on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained lightly quoted on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No trades were reported versus none on Wednesday.
- One barge, Cairo, Mississippi River, on station $500 switch, no bid, offer 90 percent of tariff.
- Four barges, Illinois River, one each week of May, no bid, offer 110 percent.
- Nineteen barges, mid-Mississippi River, two each week June and July, bid 115 percent of tariff, no comparison from Wednesday, no offer.
